experiment_data.hypothesis: PI05 + ACR-VLA on Libero-Object with adaptive_conformal_crm at conformal_threshold=0.15 (lower than central tau=0.25) will increase correction-trigger frequency and thereby explore the low-tau regime of the tau-sweep curve, allowing us to determine whether SR-vs-tau is monotonic or shows a sweet spot near 0.25 for the Object suite. Pairs with tau=0.35 (high regime) and existing tau=0.25 (central) point.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -u src/evaluate.py --model pi05 --mode adaptive_conformal_crm --K 2 --max_correction_norm 0.2 --conformal_threshold 0.15 --crm_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_pi05_unified_3suite/crm_best.pt --obs_dim 2048 --unified_obs_dim 2088 --benchmark object --seed 42 --n_rollouts 20 --output_file logs/eval_object_adaptive_pi05_tau015_seed42.json
